equivalence_proof.projection: service, mode, bytes; leases ref -> (pid, bytes, cleanup, request_active); cleanups token -> (lease, bytes, receipt)
equivalence_proof.comparison: MapSet exact typed-key membership; bounded global set of first-seen projections
equivalence_proof.fixed_scope: One Gate PID per observer; gate snapshot identity is unchanged.
equivalence_proof.equivalence: Equal raw references/scalars/maps imply identical inspected identities, sorted snapshot rows, row counts, byte sums and total-invariant outcome. Thus original serialized snapshot and digest are identical. Each first-seen projection sends its original full state in FIFO order; only subsequent equivalent states are suppressed, which the unchanged observer seen-set would also reject. Every first-distinct original receipt is retained, unless a bound fails explicitly.
excluded: other fields not read by admission_snapshot
equivalence_proof.capture: First-seen projection sends original complete app_state; original snapshot/SHA/global dedup/distinct cap/invariants run unchanged in observer. Key1025 emits sticky projection_distinct_limit; raw1025 emits unchanged sticky collector_overflow. Neither can PASS.
equivalence_proof.cost: Projection traversal, MapSet internal term hashing/exact equality and BEAM send-copy scale with bounded state sizes; no Gate inspect, sorting, crypto hashing or serialization. The key set holds at most1024 projections.
